Mangiapane scores twice, Knight makes 30 saves to help Blackhawks edge Rangers 2-1 — Andrew Mangiapane scored two power-play goals in the first period, Spencer Knight made 30 saves and the Chicago Blackhawks held off the New York Rangers 2-1 on Friday night for their fourth straight victory.
